title: PongLens
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a competitive player showing another player the thing they built. Unhurried and even, with the confidence to leave a word alone rather than push it. This is a first impression, not an instruction, so nothing is hurried and nothing is sold. No rising lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: PongLens is a performance hub for competitive table tennis.
Get any match in from your phone, or straight from YouTube.
It comes back as pure table tennis. The standing around is gone, and what is left is every point you played.
With playback built for studying the game.
Score the whole match in about ten minutes, just by saying who won each point.
A scored match can finally answer real questions. Where your serve wins. How you hold up after nine all.
Keep scoring, and the same picture builds across your season.
Placement maps show what your opponent kept doing to you, and what kept working for you.
And your coach can review the real match from anywhere. Drawings on the frame, voice notes on the exact point.
Lessons, notes, even pages from your notebook end up in one searchable journal.
Recollect brings the advice back right when you need it again.
When a rally deserves an audience, export it with the score on screen.
PongLens. Film the match once. Learn from it all season.
